Thank you. BodhiKit has very few real learners right now, so one honest account of one session is worth more than a feature request. Short answers are fine.

## What were you learning?

<!-- Topic, and roughly where you started (never touched it / used it a bit / comfortable). -->

## What worked?

<!-- A moment where the tutor did the right thing — a question that landed, a hint at the right level, a review that caught something you had forgotten. -->

## Where did it grade you wrong, or get annoying?

<!-- Too generous, too harsh, too many questions, pitched at the wrong level, a ceremony you did not want, a repeated phrase that wore thin. Be specific if you can. -->

## Would you use it again tomorrow?

<!-- Yes / no / maybe — and the one thing that would tip it. -->

## Anything else

<!-- Anything the questions above did not cover. -->
